messages.ko: 걸네다에 이어서 다시한번 더쇼에서 1위를 하게되었어 ㅠㅠㅠㅠ 많은 회사 관계자분들과 멤버들 다 너무너무 고생했고 다함께 만든 1위 자리라고 생각하지만 무엇보다 웨이브가 정말 없었으면 불가한 일들이라 너무너무 감사해 내 유일한 두 완전체활동 모두 1위라는 뜻깊은 상으로
messages.en: Following Girls Never Die, we won 1st place on The Show once again. ㅠㅠㅠㅠ Our company staff and all the members worked so, so hard, and I think this was a victory we all achieved together. But more than anything, none of this would've been possible without WAV, so I'm incredibly grateful. Both of my only full-group promotions have now been rewarded with the meaningful achievement of winning 1st place.

messages.ko: 좋은기억 만들어줘서 너무 감사하고 행복해!! 작년에도 엄청 많은 웨이브가 열심히 응원해줬지만 이번 깨어는 깜짝 놀랄정도로 응원법도 크고 응원해주는 분들도 많아진거같아서 울컥했어 너무 감동적이고 슬펐는데 렌즈를껴서 그런가…눈물이 나진 않았지만 이 마음안에선 눈물보다 더한 감동을 느꼈어…🥹웨이브는 항상 우리에게 든든한 땅과 흙이 되어주고 우린 그안에서 열심히 자라고있는 새싹같아 아직 새싹이 다 자라진 못했지만 그럼에도 우릴더 튼튼하고 멋진 나무로 만들어주기위해 힘 써줘서 감사해
messages.en: Thank you so much for giving us such wonderful memories. I'm so happy!! Last year, so many WAV cheered us on with all their hearts too, but during Are You Alive, the fan chants were so much louder and there were so many more people cheering for us than I ever imagined, and it really overwhelmed me. I was so touched and emotional. Maybe it was because I was wearing contact lenses... I didn't actually cry, but inside my heart I felt something even greater than tears. 🥹 WAV have always been the strong ground and nourishing soil beneath us, and we're like little sprouts growing with all our strength in it. We may not have fully grown yet, but thank you for continuing to help us become stronger and into an even more wonderful tree.

messages.ko: 꼭 크고 멋진 나무가 되어서 우리의 뿌리가 웨이브를 꼭 감쌌으면 좋겠다
messages.en: I hope we grow into a big, beautiful tree someday, so that our roots can embrace WAV too.
How was that? Pretty sentimental, right?
Anyway!!
Thank you so, so much, and I love you. ㅠㅠㅠ

messages.ko: 그리고 앵콜때 멋지게 라이브 불러주고싶었는데 마이크이슈로

Next time, I'll show you an even cooler performance.

because I'll be back at the salon in just a few hours.
Honestly, the salon feels like home.
I like it.
Seriously, I love you so much.
You know...
More than Y/n thinks,
I cherish you more, love you more, and Haranghae even more.
I'm truly so thankful,

messages.ko: 정말… 심상치않아 내 마음이 팬과 아티스트보다도 더 서로를 믿고 의지하는 사이인것같아
messages.en: Honestly... this feeling isn't ordinary. I feel like we've become more than just a fan and an artist—we're people who genuinely trust and rely on each other.

ㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
